prerequisites.finding: Ordinary worker registers Clean priority3 and job bans. Idle dispatch excludes locked/RPG/dead/corpse/off-map actors. NeedClean is a single CommandClean. Cleaning needs fewer than two lost hands, activity scope, valid/unlocked owner, key-stay permission and reachable path.

decision.finding: Work UI selects enable/VIP policy; Carry includes Clean. VIP changes main priority3 to2 while preserving disabled sign. NPC sorts ascending kind*100000+main*10000+workkind*100+insertion child; first enabled/unbanned/currently legal Check yielding job wins. Work-hour/health/body/magic filters remain. Command search scores squared distance minus owner/command priority, then applies eligibility/activity scope.

expenditure.finding: No direct item/purse debit in this selected path. Actor occupancy, movement and nominal Lerp(10,1,CleanSpeed/1.7) simulation-second toil are spent. Idle may extend to a nonloop animation length; exact visible time and wider needs expenditure are unobserved.

mutation.finding: Register/CurJob/start event, work-on and command lock precede stepping. Last successful toil sets Did. Successful clean leave finishes command, restoring10 beauty/removing dust and flagging room recalc; creation had applied minus10/dust.

consumer.finding: Tile beauty feeds room average, Map.GetBeauty and NpcFeeling BeautyExpect mood bands. This is atmosphere feedback; GetCleanEvaluate returns1 and is not evidence of a functional cleanliness stat.

time_policy.finding: Supplied dt drives JobEngine.Step. Cached WorkHour accumulates on CurJob changes for previous behavior category3 and positive stored day/hour; admission compares it with RuntimeVar limit. Free job probes higher-priority eligible work every5 TolSecond units, but individual jobs/toils control preemption probes. No universal per-tick preemption or daily accounting claim.

failure.finding: No eligible reachable command yields no job. Loss of worker/owner/required command or interrupted toil sets Did false; normal interrupted clean does not finish/remove dust. BeginJob replaces only interruptible current work; job or parent can reject interruption. Rain can remove outdoor cleaning commands independently and cleanup restores beauty regardless of OnFinished did.

aftermath.finding: Leave removes work-on and unlocks command for later eligible pickup. No retained partial cleaning progress established. Child jobs attach parent; successful child restores parent, interrupted child attempts parent interruption. General command ownership is distinct from simple cancel-and-restart.

prerequisites.finding: Capable wisdom actor looks around outside fight mode with shared room, vision/line of sight, same camp/compatible race, squared distance<256, awake/actionable/non-god-practicing partner and no no-communication flags. One neighbor attempted per pass. Pair cooldown and first-contact random0-100 TolSecond warmup can return before effects. Selected warm pair has no Fancy/Lover/Spouse special path.

decision.finding: Directed Value maps to a social level; level modifier clamps[-3,3]. NPC samples SayHello/Talk/DeepTalk/Neglect/Quarrel/Insult. Level0 weights50/35/3/10/2/0; level-2 weights40/5/1/40/10/4. Partner applies same kind reciprocally. This is autonomous stochastic selection, not guaranteed player outcome.

expenditure.finding: Warm Talk has no direct item/currency/stamina debit here and grants property-valued SocialContact XP. If both are free/jobless at different keys, paired JobTalk occupies each for nominal3-second toil. Relation/mood may apply without that presentation job when busy.

mutation.finding: Warm Talk sets nexttime=(0.02+0.1667*(1-K))*random(0.5,1.5)*600+TolSecond, triggers Social_Talk, adds AfterTalk favor and mood and SocialContact XP. Favor value4/max6/duration0.5; AddFavour stores NPC/definition/explanation/KeepTime0, rejects self/mutex/full stack, optionally reverse-indexes, emits ModifierFavour. It does not immediately assign BaseValue/AddValue. Story-rate0.2/actor guards can skip prose while numeric effects occur. Successful parsed story appends dated partner-linked NpcMemery, outside RPG, dropping oldest at100.

consumer.finding: For IsPlayerThing actors, Relation.Step expires labels at Duration*600, sums permanent values into AddValue and timed values into CurValue, integrates timed values into BaseValue at0.0012*FavourChangeSpeedRate*dt clamped[-100,100]. Value=clamp(BaseValue+AddValue); future level/weighted interactions reread it. Expiring AfterTalk may leave baseline drift; it is not permanent immediate+4 friendship. Separate mood value4/max3/stack0.8/duration0.5 changes mood sum, later un-applies and affects moving RealMoodValue. Separate NpcInfo renders newest prose/time/tooltip; no prose-to-job AI parser established.

time_policy.finding: Simulation dt/TolSecond, not proven offline policy. IsPlayerThing relation updates staggered at least1 second. Duration0.5 means300 simulation units for both chosen favor/mood. K lazy builder can use inclinations/shared interests/features/oppositions, but normal path creates default cache before GetRelationK; cached K0 may bypass lazy affinity initialization. Actual initialization lifecycle and exact accumulated drift are uncertain.

failure.finding: No neighbor/cooldown/first warmup yields no favor. Full favor stack rejects new label while mood can reset oldest timer. Story failure does not undo numeric interaction. Negative choices add distinct negative favor/mood; probabilistic escalation adds Fight labels/mood and possibly fight presentation. JobTalk movement/animation alone proves no injury. No romance claim.

aftermath.finding: Timed labels/moods expire separately, existing BaseValue drift remains. Surviving relations/interactive clocks and JSON-marked prose list are serialized; Relation.Step removes absent NPCs. Runtime save/reload unobserved.
